delete.summary: Through `reclaim`: the `Takeover` handle belonged to a request that has returned.

post.summary: Untraced: on a fork whose windows opened in another order it would raise the wrong one.

oneOf.description:
One press, through every point, one release. A drag for each leg draws
that many strokes; this draws one.
In notches: positive `dy` down, positive `dx` right.
Nested because `deny_unknown_fields` does not work with `flatten`.
`app` is a catalog name: an argv here would be `exec` in disguise.

active.description: Only the one the keyboard reaches.

oneOf.description: Reads the selection, or sets it when `text` is given.

keep_going.description:
Run the rest after a step is refused. A form wants the default, where
step four does not run on the assumption that step three worked; a
drawing wants this, where one refused stroke costs only that stroke.

oneOf.description: What the step read. Absent for a step that only acts.

Actor.description: `Person` marks custody, never input: a person's keystrokes go over VNC.

oneOf.description: Sway has no such state, so there it is the scratchpad.

tabs.description: Empty on a box that publishes no DevTools port.

first.description: Nothing to compare with, so the whole listing came instead.

gone.description: As they were, since they are no longer on the page.

ref.description: Given by the last `snapshot`; `@e12` names it in a query.

cut.description: There were more; the cap stopped it.

Motion.description:
How the pointer gets to a point: at once, eased along a line, or eased along a
curve a person might draw.

id.description: Valid only until the tree next changes.

oneOf.description: Both ends must fit in the window at once.

drop.description:
Take those named out of the selection instead, or empty it when
none is named.

options.description: The whole selection, for a dropdown that takes several.

enabled.description: Not disabled. A query matches a button that cannot be pressed.

load.description: Wait for the document to finish loading.

until.description: Javascript, waited on until it is truthy.

on.description: Ticked, or cleared. Already in that state is not a click.

oneOf.description:
The desktop, which answers with a hash so an unchanged screen costs
nothing; a page capture answers with the bytes every time.

saw.description:
The desktop, which answers with a hash so an unchanged screen costs
nothing; a page capture answers with the bytes every time.

Out.description:
What a reading step answers with. Typed rather than free JSON, so this
crate stays a contract and needs no JSON library of its own.

Placement.description: Not part of [`Spec`], so a placement change does not rebuild the image.

include.description: Only files whose name matches, as `*.rs`.

path.description: Where to look. A search of the whole filesystem answers in megabytes.

oneOf.description: Ignored when a window is named.

scale.description: A percentage of full size, 1 to 400.

elements.description: Empty when a delta was asked for and there was a snapshot to compare with.

total.description: What the page offers; the listing stops at the limit.

scope.description: A query as `find` takes one; the listing is what its first match holds.

oneOf.description: Boxed: a trace holds thousands of entries.
The actor is whoever held the screen, not whoever changed it.

ViewerTicket.description: Opens the viewer socket of one screen for a while, from a browser that can send no header.

taken_over.description: The screen was handed to a person and not yet reclaimed, whether or not they are connected.
